_doc: Methodology contract for the NFRI site. Rendered by harness/build_essays.py into <section id='methodology'>. Weights, λ values and gate logic are mirrored from contract/risk_model.json + contract/feature_dictionary.md — keep in sync if those change.

blocks.text: Every entity is scored on two axes — Exposure and Preparedness — each a weighted sum of five sub-factors on a 0–4 scale, rescaled to 0–100. The scoring is arithmetic in code, never a model's free-text opinion. The judgement enters only where a register cannot reach, and even there it is fused with whatever hard data exists, weighted by how much that data deserves to be trusted.

The axis score is E = (Σ wi · reff,i / 4) × 100: a weighted average of effective sub-factor ratings, where each reff is itself a fusion of a register reading and a research reading (below). Margin of Safety is simply Preparedness − Exposure, and the two median cut-lines define the four quadrants.

blocks.caption: Exposure axis — the size of the bet
head: Sub-factor
Weight
What it measures
rows: Book concentration
Share of premium / revenue in energy, property and data-centre / specialty classes.
Non-firm intensity
MW-weighted share of capacity on flexible / curtailable connections, or behind an un-progressed gate.
Aggregation / correlation
Herfindahl concentration of covered MW across grid supply points and constraint boundaries.{{cite:ACT-HHI-EIOPA}}
Trigger gap
Whether relevant cover relies on physical-damage triggers only, with no availability / parametric layer.{{cite:ACAD-TEH-WOOLNOUGH-TRIGGER,ACAD-LICHTENBERG-TRIGGER}}
Tenor mismatch
Cover / facility tenor versus the years of credible curtailment claims history.

blocks.caption: Preparedness axis — the ability to carry it
head: Sub-factor
Weight
What it measures
rows: Data & monitoring
Verifiable telemetry, datasets or audited monitoring of availability risk (no vendor self-claims).
Product fit
Count of distinct, evidenced non-damage / parametric products tied to power or data-centre risk.
Underwriting expertise
Named specialist function, evidenced via regulatory approvals or disclosed hires.
Capital & reinsurance
Financial-strength rating and Solvency II SCR-coverage, mapped to 0–4 by a fixed lookup.{{cite:PRA-SII-SCR,RATING-AMBEST-FSR}}
Pricing & modelling
Published or documented methodology for pricing availability / curtailment risk.

blocks.caption: Sub-factor weights within each axis (sum to 1.00).

blocks.text: Each sub-factor can carry two ratings: a deterministic rating derived in code from a register or filing, and a latent rating from sourced research judgement. The effective rating is a credibility-weighted blend{{cite:ACT-CREDIBILITY}} — reff = clamp[0,4]( λ·rdet + (1−λ)·rlat ) — where λ is set by the evidence tier of the deterministic input. Measured registers dominate; an assessed sub-factor falls back entirely to the research prior.

blocks.caption: Credibility weight λ by evidence tier (lowered slightly when input confidence is medium / low)
head: Tier of deterministic input
λ
Effect
rows: Measured (register)
Score is the register, essentially. Research prior barely moves it.
Derived (computed from registers)
Mostly the computed value; small room for judgement.
Disclosed (filing / rating)
Filing-led, judgement at the margin.
Assessed (no measurement)
Falls back entirely to the sourced research rating.
blocks.note: λ = max(0, λ_tier + δ_confidence), with δ = 0 / −0.05 / −0.10 for high / medium / low confidence in the deterministic input.

blocks.text: Every value carries a tier, and the tier is load-bearing: it sets λ, it gates publication, and it is shown on the entity drill-down. The harness collects data, then derives a rating from the data — the model never originates the number. Anything resting on vendor marketing, wikis or model priors is not scorable and the validator refuses it.

head: Tier
Meaning
Example
rows: Measured
Read directly from a primary register.
MW on a flexible connection in the DNO Embedded Capacity Register.
Disclosed
Stated in a filing, rating or regulatory record.
Financial-strength rating; Solvency II SCR coverage.
Derived
Computed deterministically from measured / disclosed inputs.
Herfindahl index over grid supply points.
Assessed
Sourced research judgement where no measurement exists.
Pricing capability, capped and confidence-limited.

blocks.text: No entity is published as a measurement until the blended measured + disclosed share ≥ 60% — the mean of the two axes' deterministic weight share. The gate is blended rather than per-axis on purpose: three Preparedness sub-factors (data & monitoring, underwriting expertise, pricing & modelling) are irreducibly assessed and together cap the Preparedness axis at 0.40 measurable weight, so a per-axis 60% bar is unsatisfiable there. The Exposure axis — non-firm intensity from the registers, book concentration from filings, aggregation derived from grid geography — carries the measurable load to clear the blend.

Until the live registers and filings are populated across the universe, the index sits below the gate and is labelled PROVISIONAL at the top of the page. The direction of each score is defensible; the magnitudes will move as measured data lands. The banner always states the current blended share, so the reader never mistakes an honest estimate for a measurement.

The two axes are not the destination; they are the pricing substrate for the parametric non-firm availability cover. The Margin of Safety — Preparedness minus Exposure — is read as a rating signal: a large negative margin is exposure accumulating ahead of the data, products and capital to carry it, and that gap is where the rate must rise. The Exposure sub-factors size the bet a trigger is written against; the Preparedness sub-factors say how much of it the entity can retain before it must cede.{{cite:ACT-CREDIBILITY}}

The parametric trigger itself is set off the asset's boundary curtailment probability — the measured congestion-against-firm-limit series banked per NESO constraint boundary — so the same evidence-tiered pipeline that produces a score also produces the index a payout is settled against.{{cite:NESO-CONSTRAINT-COSTS}} Methodology, index and product are one system: a number you can defend is a price you can write.
